questions.question: What are special handling notes used for in CSM?

options.text: To document technical troubleshooting steps
To bring important customer information to an agent's attention during case handling
To record agent performance feedback
To store case resolution templates

explanation.correct: Special handling notes bring important case information to an agent's attention. They can alert agents about VIP customers, specific handling requirements, or any other critical information that affects how a case should be managed.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Troubleshooting steps are documented in knowledge articles or work notes
Agent feedback is tracked through performance management tools
Resolution templates are stored separately from special handling notes

questions.question: What is the purpose of targeted communications in CSM?

options.text: To send marketing emails to potential customers
To proactively reach out to customers affected by known issues
To target specific agents for training
To communicate only with premium customers

explanation.correct: Targeted communications allow proactive outreach to customers who are affected by known issues. This enables organizations to notify customers before they contact support, improving customer experience during major incidents.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Marketing communications are separate from CSM targeted communications
Agent training is not the purpose of targeted communications
Targeted communications are based on issue impact, not customer tier

questions.question: How can customers create cases through the Service Catalog in CSM?

options.text: By calling the service desk
By submitting catalog items that are configured to create cases
By emailing the system administrator
Service Catalog cannot create cases in CSM

explanation.correct: Customers can create cases by submitting catalog items that are configured to generate cases. This allows organizations to guide customers through specific request types with appropriate information collection.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Phone calls create interactions, not Service Catalog requests
Email creates interactions, not catalog submissions
Service Catalog can definitely create cases when configured

questions.question: What are persona-based dashboards in CSM?

options.text: Dashboards customized based on the agent's personality type
Dashboards configured to show relevant metrics and data based on user role
Dashboards that display customer personas
Personal dashboards that only the owner can view

explanation.correct: Persona-based dashboards are configured to show relevant metrics and data based on the user's role. Agents, managers, and executives each see dashboards tailored to their responsibilities and decision-making needs.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Personas refer to roles, not personality types
Customer personas are different from dashboard personalization
Persona-based dashboards are role-based, not privately owned

questions.question: What portals are available for customers and consumers in CSM?

options.text: Only the IT Service Portal
Customer Service Portal, Consumer Service Portal, and Business Location Service Portal
Only the Employee Service Center
Custom portals must always be built from scratch

explanation.correct: CSM provides Customer Service Portal for B2B customers, Consumer Service Portal for B2C consumers, and Business Location Service Portal (BLSP) for location-specific service. These can be configured to meet specific needs.

wrongAnswers.explanation: IT Service Portal is for ITSM, not CSM
Employee Service Center is for HR Service Delivery
CSM includes pre-built portals that can be configured

source.excerpt: You can view the install base characteristics on the Customer Service, Consumer Service, and Business Location Service Portal (BLSP).
